method: Seeded twofold cross-fit: for each held-out source fold, estimate signed S/B from the opposite source fold and independent positive Born control. Fits use only Born covariates/all S source weights, never H/S transfer targets. Apply min(1,qraw/G * beta_channel/beta_local). Empty/nonpositive/under100-Born-event cells retain beta_channel (factor1), disclosed. H fixed because native H decisions are source-limited; generic H safety factor .42432 checked separately.
